reserves.name: Market-neutral spot collateral, perpetual hedges, and stability reserve
reserves.issuerOrObligor: StandX protocol, custodians, and undisclosed centralized-exchange counterparties

sources.label: StandX wind-down announcement, October 15, 2026 (X post: DUSD fully collateralized, redemptions close 2027-01-31)

reserveReview.rationale: Standing-structure renewal 2026-11-19: StandX announced wind-down on 2026-10-15 (yield ended, minting closed 2026-10-20, redemption requests close 2027-01-31). The announcement is the issuer's newest dated reserve statement: 'DUSD is fully collateralized. You can withdraw all assets in full', with 1:1 USDT redemption before fees under the 7-day process. The architecture, minting, redemption, product-FAQ, risks/hedging, and key-addresses pages were re-opened 2026-11-19 and still describe the same delta-neutral book (USDT/USDC converted to spot crypto with matching short perpetual hedges plus a stability reserve) with no dated balance sheet, component weights, venue inventory, or Stability Reserve Fund size; key addresses list protocol contracts only, so no custodian balances are readable on-chain. No attestation, PoR, or itemized composition was published during wind-down, and the issuer blog stops 2026-08-17. The 100% aggregate market-neutral envelope row is therefore unchanged at the conservative high tier and re-dated to the 2026-10-15 issuer assertion; weights remain undisclosed, so confidence stays manual-review with knownUnknownExposurePct 100 and the split-blocking disposition retained. DefiLlama corroborates the crypto-backed classification without a reserve breakdown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: StandX 2026-10-15 wind-down announcement (issuer assertion that DUSD is fully collateralized and redeemable in full through 2027-01-31); DUSD documentation re-opened 2026-11-19 with the market-neutral mechanism unchanged; component weights remain undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current reserve weights, exact spot constituents, exchange counterparties, custodian shares, and the Stability Reserve Fund composition are not disclosed in the reviewed primary sources or independent catalogs, and no itemized book was published after the 2026-10-15 wind-down announcement.

sources.label: StandX user terms: no trust or insolvency recourse to issuer assets

custodyProfile.uncertainty: StandX documents multi-signature custody solutions, exchange-diversified hedging, and custodial insurance coverage. The source review reopened the cited architecture, risks and legal terms on 2026-10-20 and removed the uncorroborated Ceffu provider attribution; the architecture names only a secure list of custodian addresses, not that provider. Provider shares, account segregation, and rehypothecation terms remain undisclosed. The issuer terms expressly deny any trustee relationship, assets held on trust, and tokenholder recourse to issuer or group assets on insolvency. The existing bankruptcyRemoteness none verdict is retained on that affirmative legal evidence. This source-scoped attribution correction does not renew the original custody review date or establish protective custody.
